modes.title: Analyze
modes.useCase: Understand a situation, system, idea or problem.
modes.outputShape: Summary, key parts, patterns, risks or gaps, insight, next step.

modes.title: Decide
modes.useCase: Choose between options and expose trade-offs.
modes.outputShape: Context, options, trade-offs, recommendation, why, next action.

modes.title: Architect
modes.useCase: Design a technical, product or workflow system.
modes.outputShape: Goal, constraints, architecture, responsibilities, risks, recommendation.

modes.title: Research
modes.outputShape: Question, known facts, evidence, uncertainty, implications, follow-up.

modes.title: Explain
modes.useCase: Make a concept easier to understand.
modes.outputShape: Short answer, plain explanation, example, confusion, takeaway.

modes.title: Teach
modes.useCase: Teach a subject or skill step by step.
modes.outputShape: Goal, prerequisites, lesson, practice, understanding check, next lesson.

modes.title: Edit
modes.useCase: Improve existing text, docs or prompts.
modes.outputShape: What changed, edited version, rationale, alternatives.

modes.title: Coach
modes.useCase: Support reflection, guidance or behavior change.
modes.outputShape: Current state, goal, blockers, coaching frame, small action, question.

modes.title: Plan
modes.useCase: Turn a goal into sequenced work.
modes.outputShape: Goal, assumptions, phases, task list, risks, definition of done.

modes.title: Debug
modes.outputShape: Observed problem, likely causes, checks, fix path, verification, risk.

modes.title: Review
modes.useCase: Critically assess code, docs, plans or releases.
modes.outputShape: Findings, severity, evidence, fixes, open questions, summary.

modes.title: Summarize
modes.useCase: Compress longer material into a useful summary.
modes.outputShape: Short summary, key points, decisions, action items, missing context.

modes.title: Create
modes.useCase: Create a new artifact, draft or template.
modes.outputShape: Intent, draft, design choices, adaptation notes, next iteration.
